description: Predict the next minute of lubricant-temperature change from measured friction power and thermal boundaries. A thermal resistance network competes with a speed-dependent mixing hypothesis; no future control measurements are inputs.
independent_unit: Source identification runs train except 1.4137 rad/s dev; every source validation run is test. Nonoverlapping 60-second windows; instantaneous start-state inputs only. Single robot joint.
limitations: Lumped thermal balance with measured instantaneous torque and speed
Housing, environment and friction power are held locally constant over 60 seconds; later controls are never supplied
Capacity and conductances are effective quantities; one joint, no independent-machine validation
Convection proxy, not direct measurement of lubricant circulation
title: Frictional heating in a robot gearbox
